newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-BENNY THE DIP IN IMPRESSIVE EPSOM TRIAL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-BENNY THE DIP IN IMPRESSIVE EPSOM TRIAL.

text.p: Benny the Dip, ridden by Frenchman Olivier Peslier, made all the running on Wednesday to win the Dante Stakes, one of the best guides over the years to the Epsom Derby.
Benny the Dip is now as low as 7-1 second favourite for next month's classic behind 5-4 favourite Entrepreneur, winner of the 2,000 Guineas at Newmarket.
Peslier, who won the Dante last year on Glory of Dancer, never had an anxious moment on the 100-30 favourite, coming home by two and a half lengths from Desert Story (4-1), ridden by Michael Kinane.
Winning trainer John Gosden said: "He's won nicely."
